name: rig_model
description: Rig a 3D model (.glb) on Tripo: add a skeleton so animate_model can move it. Tripo's free riggability check runs first; a model it calls not riggable fails with not_riggable and nothing is spent. biped gets Mixamo bone names. A model made by generate_model is rigged from its Tripo task; any other .glb is uploaded. Running it again with the same --out re-attaches to the task instead of paying twice. Standalone.

output.description: Path to the rigged .glb. With --json: {path, taskId, rigType, rigModel, spec, creditsUsed, textures}.

params.name: model
params.description: The .glb to rig (a character or creature).

params.name: out
params.description: Output .glb path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: rig-type
params.description: Skeleton type. Default: the one Tripo's free check recommends.

params.name: task-id
params.description: A rig task already submitted (a run that stopped): wait for it and download it. No new task, no new charge. Give --rig-type with it, so the file can be animated.
